summary: Implemented the minimal search.paths(root) source and a bounded internal scope explanation. Path discovery emits typed eligible-file rows without opening content, preserves the distinction between an empty resolved scope and a missing root, and records aggregate policy/counter evidence without returning skipped-path lists.

review.reviewer: separate grill-code review pass (no independent subagent was available)

startingState.head: adf0dacf4c8008468d64ade51a18df28a9c4fe5d
startingState.worktree: Tracked files were clean at scope start; the local ignored campaign state recorded W04-S05 as in_progress. W04-S05 implementation, tests and evidence were added afterward.
startingState.aheadNote: The ahead count includes the retained pre-existing campaign-state commit; 24 preceding reachable commits carry completed Search scope trailers.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search implementation, package description, tests and W04-S05 evidence were changed. No sibling repository, query-engine adapter, release, publish or install surface was modified.
implementation.pathsContract: search.paths(root) exposes one row per eligible regular-file path with Path, nullable Origin and EntryKind=file. It reuses the established scope traversal and performs no candidate content reads.
implementation.scopeExplanation: The internal explanation reports requested/resolved root identity, root kind, scope resolution, normalized applied policy settings, FilesConsidered, MetadataReads, EligibleFiles, MetadataRejected, CandidatesYielded and ContentOpenAttempts. Its summary is aggregate and does not enumerate skipped or unrelated paths.
implementation.failureSemantics: A resolved empty directory completes with zero rows and an explanation; a missing root retains the typed SEARCH-SOURCE-001 source-access diagnostic and no successful explanation is published.
implementation.planning: The Search planner recognizes paths while leaving unsupported predicate, order and window work residual; no path-specific pushdown is claimed.
implementation.cancellation: Path traversal links the writer cancellation token with SourceExecutionContext.EndWorkToken and disposes the linked token source.

requiredCoverage: typed path rows and compiled search.paths constructor
zero content-open attempts during path discovery
bounded policy/count explanation without skipped-path expansion
resolved empty scope versus typed missing-root failure

commands.executionWrapper: Direct PowerShell invocation with separate stdout/stderr capture; product argv is recorded above.

gateResults.evidence: The exact owning-repository Release suite exited 0 with 21 projects, 1,360 discovered, 1,326 passed, 0 failed and 34 skips; the focused Search suite exited 0 with 73 passed and 3 platform-conditional skips.
The separate review approved the bounded source/explanation design; exact source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are retained and verified after commit finalization.

Real temporary-file and compiled-query tests prove typed path rows, eligible-file cardinality, zero content-open attempts, bounded aggregate explanation and distinct empty-scope versus missing-root behavior.
The path source uses the existing cancellation-aware Search frontier, preserves typed traversal failures, and links/disposes execution-context cancellation without changing matches behavior.

knownLimitations: Scope options and the explanation object remain internal until the later request-binder and audit scopes expose their ratified public shapes.
Explanation counts describe a live filesystem traversal rather than an atomic snapshot.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 existing classified skips and the three W04-S04 platform-conditional symlink fixture skips; no package was published.
